workflow:
name: Authenticate Hanlin Upstream Candidate
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['Check RuntimeCore Dependency Updates']
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      proof_run:
        description: Original completed candidate workflow run
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
  checks: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: upstream-proof-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || inputs.proof_run }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  evidence:
    if: github.repository == 'davidpovarsky/hanlin-ai' && github.ref_name == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      TRUSTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ vars.HANLIN_UPSTREAM_TRUSTED_SHA }}
      PROOF_RUN: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || inputs.proof_run }}
      ALLOW_AUTO_MERGE: ${{ vars.HANLIN_UPSTREAM_ACCEPTANCE_AUTOMERGE == 'true' && 'true' || 'false' }}
    steps:
      - name: Require an immutable reviewed consumer source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$TRUSTED_SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "$PROOF_RUN" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.HANLIN_UPSTREAM_TRUSTED_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify the trusted checkout identity
        shell: bash
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TRUSTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: '24.22.1'
      - name: Authenticate current-head schema2 evidence and all required gates
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          node Scripts/Runtime/consume-upstream-run.mjs
          davidpovarsky/hanlin-ai "$PROOF_RUN"
          codex/upstream-acceptance-base-20261119-v3
          publish "$ALLOW_AUTO_MERGE"
      - name: Preserve the independent consumer and mutation journal
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: upstream-consumer-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: build/upstream-proof-consumer
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
